name: Lich King
summary: In Icecrown, the Lich King commands the undead Scourge from the frozen throne. Kil'jaeden made him from the spirit of the orc shaman ner'zhul. His power drew Prince Arthas Menethil toward corruption, until the two joined atop Northrend's icy peaks.

sections.title: Birth of the Frozen God
sections.body:
Ner'zhul fled dying Draenor, but Kil'jaeden seized him. The demon lord tore away his body and bound his tormented soul in diamond-hard ice from the Twisting Nether. That glacial prison struck Northrend's northern wastes and formed the frozen throne.

Kil'jaeden meant the Lich King to forge an unstoppable undead vanguard. It would break the mortal kingdoms without the infighting that had ruined the Orcish Horde. Yet Ner'zhul wielded immense telepathic power, and began at once to plot his freedom.

sections.title: The Fall of Lordaeron
sections.body:
Watching dreadlords guarded Ner'zhul closely, so he acted in secret. Through his mind, he ensnared Kel'Thuzad, an exiled Kirin Tor archmage. Kel'Thuzad founded the Cult of the Damned in Lordaeron, where cauldrons of tainted grain spread the Plague of Undeath through the northern kingdoms.

Prince Arthas Menethil rushed to save his people, but desperation drove him to ruthless acts, including the infamous slaughter of Stratholme. Seeking vengeance against the dreadlord Mal'Ganis, Arthas pursued him to Northrend. There Frostmourne waited to steal his soul and make him the Scourge's foremost death knight.

sections.title: Treachery and Ascendance
sections.body:
For a time, the Lich King summoned Archimonde and yielded command to the Burning Legion. He expected the demons' hubris. Arthas turned the demon hunter Illidan Stormrage toward the Skull of Gul'dan and Tichondrius's death. That helped bring about Archimonde's ruin at Mount Hyjal.

Afterward, a desperate Kil'jaeden ordered Illidan to destroy the frozen throne. Cracks in the icy spire weakened Ner'zhul's power, and Sylvanas Windrunner and her Forsaken broke free. The Lich King summoned his champion back. Arthas returned to Northrend, defeated Illidan at icecrown's foot, climbed the spire, and shattered the ice. He joined with Ner'zhul as one terrible consciousness.

faq.q: Who is the Lich King right now?
faq.answer: The Lich King is Prince Arthas Menethil joined with the orc shaman ner'zhul. Arthas shattered the glacial prison atop the frozen throne in icecrown and donned the Helm of Domination. His mortal form and dark soul joined with Ner'zhul's spirit, and he rules the Scourge.

faq.q: Why did the Burning Legion create him?
faq.answer: Kil'jaeden made the Lich King to weaken Azeroth's defenders before a full demonic invasion. The previous invasion had failed amid the mortal Orcish Horde's internal quarrels. So Kil'jaeden sought an army of the dead under telepathic control, one that would obey and exhaust mortal armies.

faq.q: Where is the Lich King located?
faq.answer: The Lich King sits on the frozen throne atop icecrown's glacier, in remote, frozen Northrend. The continent lies far across the Great Sea, north of Lordaeron.

faq.q: How did Sylvanas break free from his control?
faq.answer: Illidan Stormrage struck the frozen throne with powerful sorcery, fracturing its ice and weakening the Lich King's power. Some undead regained their free will, rallied under Sylvanas Windrunner, and founded the Forsaken.

Frostmourne is a cursed runeblade that steals souls. It was sent from the frozen throne to draw in a mortal champion. In Northrend, it lured Prince Arthas Menethil to claim it, devoured his soul, and made him the Scourge's foremost death knight.

Ner'zhul was an elder orc shaman of Draenor. As he fled his dying homeworld through dimensional rifts, Kil'jaeden captured him, tore away his flesh, and warped his spirit into the all-seeing mind that became the Lich King.

angles.text: The Forsaken began when the Lich King's telepathic grip faltered. Queen Sylvanas leads her people with burning hatred for their former master in the frozen north.

For humans, the Lich King is bound to a terrible tragedy. Prince Arthas, heir to Lordaeron's throne and a paladin of the Silver Hand, murdered his father and destroyed his kingdom in the entity's name.
The Order of the Silver Hand was shattered by the Lich King's corrupting power. That power made their greatest champion a death knight, and he struck down Uther the Lightbringer.
The Scourge twists the Light's sanctity into something grim. It reminds holy practitioners of the terrible cost paid across Lordaeron's fallen parishes.
